coverage_limits: No qualifying same-day submission or revision was verified in the browsed source set as of the stated cutoff. Three earlier papers were newly screened in this run.

Bounded live browser discovery with selective arXiv cs.GR, cs.CV and cs.HC listing inspection. Listing dates are not submission dates. Not every listed abstract was read; cs.AI, cs.RO, cs.MM and eess.IV were not separately enumerated.
Hugging Face target-date page was inaccessible on the initial attempt and one retry. OpenReview and official venues received indexed searches only; no exhaustive proceedings or forum traversal.
The live source document revision differs from the pinned October 11 codebook. Classifications retain that pinned codebook; the new document was not reconciled.
The installed skill prepare/finalize workflow ran with live browser retrieval. This is not a separate API harness benchmark run.
Two papers received selected-method reading, DirCast remains scope-dependent after abstract-only screening, and 4DMemory was excluded from its abstract. Remaining leads are queued.
Search indexes can lag; this bounded pass does not establish field-wide completeness.

papers.canonical_title: SceneAgent: An Agentic Pipeline from 3D and 4D Captures to Simulation Environments
papers.abstract: Coordinates capture reconstruction, physical modeling and simulator inspection to create editable simulation environments from 3D and 4D captures.
papers.screening_reason: Agents inspect intermediate simulator outputs and revise geometry or transforms, providing an explicit graphics authoring feedback loop.

screening_evidence.evidence: An orchestrator plans conversion; agents run tools and use actor-critic visual inspection to repair poses and assets. Geometric thresholds check alignment. Inputs include images, videos and 3D captures; output contains meshes, transforms, physical properties and joints.

papers.contribution: Coordinates capture reconstruction, physical modeling and simulator inspection to create editable simulation environments from 3D and 4D captures.
papers.limitations: Physical parameters are approximate; selected method passages were inspected, not a complete replication.

papers.canonical_title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
papers.abstract: Evaluates agents that write executable programs to produce complete videos with sound, using 239 tasks and requirement-based evaluation.
papers.screening_reason: A benchmark directly evaluating agent-authored graphics and audiovisual artifacts.

screening_evidence.evidence: Tasks provide language specifications and optional assets. Agents deliver a video, editable source and timing sheet. Separate program checks and judge panels evaluate delivered artifacts.

papers.contribution: Evaluates agents that write executable programs to produce complete videos with sound, using 239 tasks and requirement-based evaluation.
papers.limitations: Benchmark judges are held-out evaluation; they are not assumed to provide feedback during agent execution.

papers.canonical_title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
papers.abstract: Uses a streaming video-language model to choose broadcast cameras and generate synchronized esports commentary.
papers.screening_reason: Camera selection affects a visual broadcast, but its fit to the survey graphics-authoring scope needs review.
